title: Corino survives the beatings and becomes champion
summary: Steve Corino evolves from an irritating antagonist into a credible championship contender. His willingness to endure punishment helps him reach ECW’s top title in its final months.

chapters.title: Tajiri defeats Corino
chapters.result: Tajiri wins a punishing singles match.
chapters.context: Although Corino loses, the performance adds physical credibility to his provocative persona.

chapters.title: Corino wins Double Jeopardy
chapters.result: Corino defeats Lynn, Credible and Sandman to become world champion.
chapters.context: His rise culminates in the complicated four-man title contest.

chapters.title: Sandman takes the championship
chapters.result: Sandman defeats Corino and Credible in the tables, ladders, chairs and canes match.
chapters.context: Corino’s reign ends at what becomes the original promotion’s last pay-per-view.
